_comment: Single source of truth for ML model artifacts (Phase 3.4 / 6.8). Committed in-repo because the artifacts themselves (models/, data/models/) are gitignored and local-only — this survives a disk loss and documents what SHOULD exist. 'metric' values are recorded AS STORED; read 'metric_caveat' for the honest read. status: live = served by the API; prototype = built, not wired; dormant = code exists, not imported; deprecated = superseded, delete after off-machine backup.

content_classifier.task: Pre-upload overperform classifier (views vs channel baseline)
content_classifier.metric_caveat: 0.746 is random-split (mild inflation). Honest channel-grouped CV (Phase 6.1) = bal-acc ~0.690 / AUC ~0.814. The old '90-94%' docstring claim is UNSUBSTANTIATED. A lean 25-feature variant (data/models/clean_predictor_lean.pkl, holdout 0.701) drops the embedding dependency for ~equal accuracy; swap deferred (needs tier-threshold recalibration).

velocity_horizons.task: View-count projection across checkpoint horizons (from -> to)
velocity_horizons.metric_caveat: Stored R² 0.91-0.99 is AUTOCORRELATION, not skill — closer horizons (7d->14d, 14d->30d) score highest precisely because views barely change (trivial persistence). One stored 'accuracy' is -4138 (broken). NOT a real accuracy. Honest metric = lift over persistence baseline via scripts/backtest_predictions.py (first live signal: 1h->6h MAPE 51%, median growth 3.83x). Trained on the now-LOST scrape; cannot be retrained until the rebuilt dataset matures (~30d).

velocity_v3_single.metric_caveat: The '90-94% accuracy' in the docstring is UNSUBSTANTIATED (same autocorrelation issue). velocity_predictor_v2 + the per-horizon index supersede this. Confirm whether the velocity router still loads this; if not, deprecate.

reach_predictor.task: Absolute breakout / reach (top-quartile views-per-subscriber) from thumbnail+title
reach_predictor.loader: (prototype — not yet wired to the API)
reach_predictor.metric_caveat: Honest channel-grouped AUC 0.615 vs 0.51 (chance) for hand-crafted-alone on this target — thumbnails/titles ARE the signal for absolute reach (Phase 6.1). Frozen-CLIP baseline; SUPERSEDED by the end-to-end fine-tune (reach_predictor_clip) which scored 0.667. Kept as the fallback when torch is unavailable.

reach_predictor_clip.task: Absolute breakout / reach from thumbnail+title — end-to-end fine-tuned CLIP
reach_predictor_clip.type: frozen CLIP ViT-B/32 (img+text) + trained fusion head (linear probe)
reach_predictor_clip.metric_caveat: HEAD-ONLY linear probe beat both the frozen-XGBoost baseline (0.615) and the full end-to-end fine-tune (0.667): val AUC 0.668. Finding: unfreezing the CLIP backbone added nothing — the breakout signal is already in frozen CLIP's projected embeddings; only the fusion head matters. Artifact is just the 4 head tensors (~1MB) + stock CLIP from HF, so prod-deliverable (vs 578MB full-state). Served by the candidate ranker (src/features/reach_model.py).

breakout_detector.task: Early breakout detector (7.3): P(top-quartile channel-relative overperformance at 24h) from 6h signals
breakout_detector.type: single-feature (early views vs channel leave-one-out baseline) + isotonic calibration

1h.note: earlier call, honestly lower certainty (P caps at 0.845); loaded via calibrator_path('1h')

breakout_detector.metric_caveat: HONEST grouped-CV AUC 0.93 (scripts/evaluate_breakout.py). Deliberately a single explainable feature: a full XGBoost on all early features adds only +0.01-0.016 AUC, so this captures ~99% of the achievable signal. This is the *classification* reframe — the velocity POINT predictor loses to baseline on MAPE (docs/velocity_eval_report.md), but breakout is highly predictable. Probability is isotonic-calibrated. Trained on the rebuilt collection; re-fit as data matures. Channel baseline needs the channel's other tracked videos at the same checkpoint.

dormant_and_deprecated.task: Code exists but NOT imported by the API/features — carry random-split leakage, serve no users
dormant_and_deprecated.metric_caveat: Decide per the data-loss note (memory/ml-data-disconnected.md): wire up under grouped CV or delete. Do NOT delete blindly — models/ + data/ are gitignored and exist on ONE machine; back up off-machine first.
